Abby - Waterproof golf jacket.descriptionEn:
The Abby jacket combines modern design with the high-performance features you expect from Galvin Green’s rainwear collection. Made from Pertex® Shield 3-layer stretch fabric, this jacket is fully waterproof and windproof, offering excellent breathability to keep you comfortable in any weather. 
 

 
The stretch fabric ensures freedom of movement, while the adjustable cuffs and elastic drawstring at the hem provide a customisable fit. The bold white stripe down the sleeves is sporty and bright. With front pockets, a two-way zipper, and shaped sleeves for ease of movement, the Abby jacket is perfect for the active golfer who demands performance and style. This jacket is part of Galvin Green's DRYVR™ rain collection and is PFAs-free.
fabricEn: Facing fabric: 85% recycled polyamide/15% elastane with PU membrane

Adam - Waterproof Golf Jacket.descriptionEn:
Described as “the new gold standard for golf waterproofs” — Galvin Green’s Pertex Shield collection showcases the next generation of golf rain gear. The Adam half zip waterproof jacket merges the performance features of a high-tech golf jacket with the ease of a pullover. Made from Pertex Shield 3-layer stretch fabric, this lightweight, breathable jacket keeps you dry and comfortable. Garment features include chest tabs that reduce the bulk at the front of the jacket during your swing, and repositioned side seams to reduce friction.
 

 
Part of Galvin Green’s DRYVR™ rainproof range, Pertex Shield stretch garments have a hydrophilic PU membrane, designed to attract and retain water molecules due to the membrane’s “water-loving” nature. This 3-layer fabric is softer and more stretchy, and creates a superior next-to-skin comfort with a ‘slide’n’glide’ effect to reduce friction with garments worn underneath.
featuresEn: Chest tabs for adjustable chest width
Repositioned side seam for optimum comfort
fabricEn: Facing fabric: 85% recycled polyamide/15% elastane with PU membrane

The material is windproof and has a water repellent finish, without compromising on breathability. With front and back pockets, these pants are functional, and we love the streamlined cut. Rated with warming effect #2, these pants are ideal when it's too cold for regular golf pants and too dry for waterproof pants.
 

 
The Levana windproof women’s golf pants are ideal when you need protection from the elements but the conditions aren’t wet enough for waterproof pants. These stylish windproof and water-repellent pants keep out the cold but are extremely breathable and are made from a stretch fabric for comfort and ease of movement.
fabricEn: Facing fabric: 86% nylon / 14% spandex with PU membrane

Lewis - Windproof golf gloves.descriptionEn:
Meant to be worn snuggly, the Lewis warm golf gloves combine leather and windproof INTERFACE-1™ fabric, and are available in six sizes to fit everyone.
 

 
Lewis are our popular windproof golf gloves, designed to be worn on windy days. Made from a mix of leather for grip, and our INTERFACE™ fabric for protection against the wind, these gloves are a must-have.

Linden - Hooded Golf Windbreaker.descriptionEn:
The Linden hooded windbreaker from the GALVIN GREEN CONCEPT collection combines performance and style with its curved seam details and front full hood. Made from stretch fabric with a water-repellent finish, this jacket is designed to keep you comfortable and protected in varying conditions. 
 

 
The Warming Effect #2 ensures added warmth, while the breathable fabric prevents overheating. Featuring repositioned side seams for optimum comfort and a kangaroo pocket for storage, this jacket also boasts an elastic drawstring at the hem for a secure fit.
featuresEn: Repositioned side seams for optimum comfort
fabricEn: 100% recycled polyester with recycled PES membrane

Lissy - Windproof and water repellent go.descriptionEn:
Wind, cold, and light rain are the most common conditions you’ll face on the golf course, which is why we designed the INTERFACE-1™ range. The Lissy golf windbreaker is a long sleeve zip up made from an extremely breathable, stretch fabric that’s bluesign® approved.
 

 
Features include front pockets, elastic drawstring at the hem, and a two way front zipper. Rated with warming effect #2, Lissy can be worn over a shirt in cool weather, or over several layers in cold conditions.
fabricEn: 100% recycled polyester with recycled PES membrane
Lissy - Windproof and water repellent go.modelInfoEn: The model is 5' 4" / 164cm and wears size XS

Lloyd - Windproof and water repellent go.descriptionEn:
Wind, cold, and light rain are the most common conditions you’ll face on the golf course, which is why we designed the INTERFACE-1™ range. The Lloyd golf windbreaker features a sporty two tone design with contrasting panels, and a bold back stripe. Made from a windproof, water repellent fabric, Lloyd’s extreme breathability and stretch features allow the wearer full freedom of movement, making it an ideal jacket for the golf course
 

 
Featuring front pockets, elasticated cuffs and an elastic drawstring waist, this jacket is cut for comfort. The repositioned side seam reduces garment friction while you swing. Lloyd is made from a bluesign® approved recycled polyester.
featuresEn: Repositioned side seam for optimum comfort
fabricEn: 100% recycled polyester with recycled PES membrane
Lloyd - Windproof and water repellent go.modelInfoEn: The model is 5' 9" / 180cm and wears size M

London - Windproof and water repellent g.descriptionEn: London pairs INTERFACE-1™ protection with strategic Thermore® padding for exceptional warmth in cold, windy conditions. The jacket’s color-blocked sleeves add a dynamic contrast, while the full-zip closure ensures easy layering. Bluesign® approved materials highlight its responsible construction. With breathable stretch side panels and a regular fit, London keeps movement fluid while maintaining a stable microclimate - perfect for demanding autumn and winter rounds.
featuresEn: Repositioned side seam for optimum comfort

Luca - Windproof and water repellent gol.descriptionEn: Luca blends premium warmth with a sleek silhouette, pairing Thermore® padding and INTERFACE-1™ stretch panels for a balanced thermal experience. The color-blocked top section delivers a modern look, while the recycled materials boost sustainability. Breathable and windproof, Luca is ideal for layering over a mid layer on crisp mornings. Its streamlined profile ensures full mobility, making it a versatile essential for transitional play.

Luis - Windproof and water repellent gol.descriptionEn:
The Luis vest is an ultra-lightweight, quarter-zip windbreaker designed for maximum performance on warmer days. Weighing just 94g (3.34 ounces) in size medium, it offers the perfect balance of protection and breathability without the bulk. Made with INTERFACE-1™ technology fabric and Warming Effect #1, this short-sleeve vest is windproof and features a water-repellent finish to keep you dry in light rain. 
 

 
The stretchy fabric ensures full range of motion, while the elastic drawstring at the hem provides a secure fit. Ideal for layering over a shirt or mid-layer, the Luis vest is a versatile piece that offers both comfort and freedom during your round.

Luna - Windproof and water repellent gol.descriptionEn: The Luna women’s windproof golf vest offers versatile warmth and protection — ideal as a standalone layer on crisp days or slipped under your golf jacket for extra insulation. Made from recycled polyester with a stretch, water-repellent fabric, it delivers windproof performance and exceptional breathability. This INTERFACE-1™ garment is rated with Warming Effect #3 and comes complete with Thermore® padding and bluesign® approved materials. Thoughtful details like front pockets, a two-way zipper, an elastic drawstring hem, and repositioned side seams ensure a flattering fit and freedom of movement for any outdoor pursuit.
featuresEn: Repositioned side seam for optimum comfort
Main fabric is bluesign® approved and OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified
fabricEn: 100% recycled polyester with recycled PES membrane

Lydia - Windproof and water repellent go.descriptionEn: The Lydia jacket is a high-tech INTERFACE-1™ windbreaker designed to keep you warm without restricting your swing. Made from 100% recycled polyester with a PET membrane and filled with Thermore® padding made from recycled materials, it delivers windproof, water-repellent protection and exceptional breathability. Featuring stretch fabric, an elastic drawstring hem, and repositioned side seams, Lydia moves with you for maximum freedom on and off the course. Practical details like front pockets, a two-way zipper, and elasticated cuffs in matching body fabric complete this bluesign® approved design for sustainable performance.
featuresEn: Repositioned side seam for optimum comfort
Main fabric is bluesign® approved and OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified
fabricEn: 100% recycled polyester with recycled PES membrane

Maggio - Breathable short sleeve golf sh.descriptionEn: Introducing Maggio, the statement shirt that stands out with a bold, contrasting diagonal stripe across the front. Designed with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology, this shirt offers superior breathability and quick-dry properties to keep you cool and comfortable on the course. The stretch fabric ensures flexibility, while the ribbed collar and cuffs provide a sporty look. With UV protection 20+, this shirt also helps shield you from the sun’s harmful rays.

Maguire - Breathable short sleeve golf s.descriptionEn: The Maguire shirt features a tonal print inspired by wind and waves, offering both style and performance. Designed with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology, this shirt is extremely breathable and quick-drying, keeping you comfortable throughout your round. The stretch fabric ensures freedom of movement, while the tailored collar and single fold sleeve hem add a refined touch. With UV protection 20+, this shirt also helps shield you from the sun’s harmful rays, making it the ideal choice for warm-weather golfing.

Mansfield - Breathable short sleeve golf.descriptionEn: The Mansfield shirt combines style and functionality with stripes on the ribbed collar and a G logo pattern for a classic, sporty look. Designed for breathability and comfort, this shirt is quick-drying and made with stretch fabric for enhanced movement on the course. The ribbed collar and single fold sleeve hem provide a refined finish, while UV protection 20+ helps shield you from the sun.

Marielle - Breathable golf skirt with in.descriptionEn: The Marielle golf skirt combines style and performance, featuring a delicate pattern with a hidden cursive logo or available in solid colours. Made from breathable, quick-drying VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric, this skirt offers UV protection 20+ to shield you from the sun. The stretch fabric ensures flexibility and comfort, while the inner shorts provide added support and coverage. Front pockets are perfect for carrying small essentials.

Marty - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: Marty is back: a solid shirt with a contrasting colour on the collar and sleeve edges. This is a classic shirt with an edge — literally and figuratively. Made from stretch fabric, it offers excellent breathability and quick-drying performance, keeping you comfortable all day. With UV protection (20+) and ribbed collar and cuffs, Marty combines timeless style with modern functionality.

Maya - Breathable sleeveless golf shirt.descriptionEn: Maya refreshes the sleeveless silhouette with a modern V-shaped collar and an expressive all-over print. The VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric delivers exceptional breathability and quick-dry properties, keeping you cool when temperatures rise. The stretchy fabric ensures complete freedom of movement, while the soft handfeel enhances comfort across long rounds. Elegant and athletic, Maya is equally suited to competitive play and warm-weather leisure.

Medley - Breathable short sleeve golf sh.descriptionEn: Medley showcases a refined print and streamlined silhouette tailored for warm-weather comfort. Engineered with VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric, it promotes airflow and quick evaporation, helping you stay focused as the heat builds. Its gentle stretch ensures fluid motion, while the tailored collar elevates the look. Soft, light, and expressive, Medley is designed for golfers who appreciate both visual character and reliable performance.

Merry - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: Merry brings a fresh, expressive look to the course with its bold botanical print and refined contrast details. The contrast knitted collar and sleeve cuffs frame the vibrant pattern, giving the shirt a modern, athletic edge. Made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology, Merry offers superior breathability, rapid moisture-wicking, and a soft, lightweight stretch fabric that ensures unrestricted movement throughout your swing. With UV 20+ protection and a quick-dry feel, this high-performance polo keeps you cool, confident, and ready to play your best on warm, sunny rounds.

Mia - Breathable sleeveless golf shirt.descriptionEn: The Mia sleeveless golf shirt combines performance and style with a delicate printed pattern featuring a hidden cursive logo. Designed from breathable, quick-drying fabric, this shirt offers UV protection 20+ to shield you from the sun during your round. The stretch fabric ensures flexibility and comfort, while the tailored collar adds a polished look.

Miley - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: Introducing Miley, a women’s golf shirt with a silver zip front and sporty raglan sleeves. The shirt features white panels on the sleeves, adding a dynamic touch to this athletic design. Made from breathable, quick-drying fabric, Miley offers UV protection 20+ to keep you shielded from the sun. The stretch fabric provides flexibility, while the stand-up collar and zipper opening make this a unique golf shirt.

Mitchell - Breathable short sleeve golf.descriptionEn: Mitchell is a classic, simple polo shirt with contrasting side panels and a stripe at the centre back. Featuring VENTIL8™ PLUS technology, it delivers extreme breathability, quick‑dry performance, and UV 20+ protection in a soft, stretchy fabric. Finished with a ribbed collar, single‑fold sleeve hem, and sleeve end cuffs, Mitchell combines timeless style with modern functionality for active wear.

Molly - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: Riding on the popularity of the men’s Marty shirt, Molly is the women’s equivalent, offering a classic golf polo with a striped ribbed collar and cuffs. Part of the VENTIL8™ PLUS range, this shirt delivers superior breathability, quick-drying properties, and UV protection 20+. The stretch fabric ensures flexibility and comfort, making it the perfect choice for golfers who value both style and performance. With its classic colours and timeless design, Molly is a core style that will stay in your rotation for seasons to come.

Mona - Breathable short sleeve golf shir.descriptionEn: The Mona golf shirt offers a sporty look with a buttonless placket and contrasting colours on the placket and stripe panels. Designed with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology, this shirt is extremely breathable and quick-drying, making it the perfect choice for warm-weather golf. The stretch fabric provides flexibility, while the tailored collar and single fold sleeve hem add a classic touch. With UV protection 20+, this shirt also shields you from harmful sun rays, ensuring you stay comfortable and protected throughout your round.

Moon - Breathable short sleeve golf shir.descriptionEn: The Moon shirt is a classic solid golf shirt featuring a ribbed collar with a contrasting stripe for a stylish, sporty look. Made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology fabric, this shirt offers exceptional breathability and quick-drying properties, ensuring comfort throughout your round. The stretch fabric allows for ease of movement, while the soft, comfortable feel makes it ideal for extended wear. With UV protection 20+, the Moon shirt also shields you from the sun’s harmful rays.

Muir - Breathable short sleeve golf shir.descriptionEn: Muir features a dynamic all-over print with soft tonal layering, offering visual interest without overwhelming the silhouette. Crafted from VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric, it ensures excellent ventilation and rapid moisture transport. Stretch fibres encourage unrestricted motion, while the classic polo structure keeps the design grounded. Muir is an expressive yet refined option for players seeking standout style and advanced comfort.

Mulligan - Breathable short sleeve golf.descriptionEn: Mulligan channels modern simplicity through strong colour blocking and a technical sleeve accent. The VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric enhances airflow and dries quickly, ensuring comfort during long, sunny rounds. Gentle mechanical stretch supports a natural swing path, while the ribbed collar adds a tailored finish. With its bold shoulder contrast and dependable performance, Mulligan is a confident warm-weather staple.

Myles - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: The Myles golf shirt from the GALVIN GREEN CONCEPT collection combines functionality and style with curved raglan sleeves and a black and white striped ribbed collar and cuffs. Designed for breathability and comfort, this shirt is quick-drying and offers UV protection 20+ to shield you from the sun. The stretch fabric provides flexibility, ensuring a full range of motion while you play.

Myron - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn: The Myron golf shirt from the GALVIN GREEN CONCEPT collection features a curved yoke design with a black ribbed collar and cuffs, adding a modern edge to a classic piece. Made for breathability, this shirt is quick-drying and offers UV protection 20+ to keep you cool and shielded from the sun. The stretch fabric ensures comfort and flexibility, while the soft texture adds to the overall wearability.

Nea - Breathable golf pants.descriptionEn: The Nea golf pants offer a slim cut design, combining style and performance for the modern golfer. Made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology fabric, these pants are extremely breathable, quick-drying, and lightweight, ensuring comfort throughout your round. The mechanical stretch fabric provides flexibility, while UV protection 20+ shields you from the sun’s harmful rays. Features include front and back pockets for convenience.

Nellie - Breathable golf pants.descriptionEn:
Introducing Nellie, a new high-waisted technical golf pant with a straight leg. Designed to be worn during activity, as an everyday pant, or even to wear to the office, Nellie is a stretch activewear pant disguised as tailored trousers. An alternative to our classic Nicole golf pant, this innovative new cut is made from a super soft and comfortable 4-way stretch fabric. Featuring convenient pockets and extreme breathability, we dare you to pair them with a dressy top on a night out — no one will believe you are wearing stretch pants.
 

 
The Nellie ladies’ slim cut golf pants are made from a fabric with mechanical stretch and offer UV protection of 15+. Part of Galvin Green’s VENTIL8™ PLUS range of pants, shorts, and skirts, Nellie has front and back pockets and is made from a quickdry fabric that’s easy to care for.

Nick - Breathable golf pants.descriptionEn: The Nick golf pants are designed with a lightweight, straight cut for a comfortable and modern fit. Made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology fabric, these pants offer excellent breathability and quick-drying properties, keeping you cool and comfortable on the course. The mechanical stretch fabric allows for flexibility, while UV protection 20+ shields you from the sun. Featuring both front and back pockets, the Nick pants offer all-day comfort.

Nina - Breathable golf skirt with inner.descriptionEn: The Nina golf skirt offers a straight, tailored fit, designed for both comfort and performance on the course. Made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology fabric, this skirt is extremely breathable, quick-drying, and lightweight. The mechanical stretch fabric provides flexibility for easy movement, while UV protection 20+ keeps you shielded from the sun. Front and back pockets offer practicality, and inner shorts provide extra comfort and coverage.

Nixon - Breathable golf pants.descriptionEn:
With front pockets, back pockets, and a mechanical stretch, the Nixon golf pants for men are comfortable, practical, and easy to wear. Available in 16 sizes, these pants will fit a wide variety of golfers. Plus, this soft, lightweight fabric is bluesign® approved. Stay comfortable on hot days with golf clothing that’s been designed by golfers, for golfers
 

 
Our most lightweight golf pants for men, Nixon, are made from a light material that is perfect for sunny days. Made from a stretch fabric that’s extremely breathable, these pants are our first choice when you are golfing in hot weather. Quick dry properties ensure you stay cool and dry, while UV protection of 20+ gives you extra cover when the sun is shining.

Noah - Breathable golf pants.descriptionEn:
These men’s golf pants incorporate a shirt gripper waistband and stretch function for a perfect fit. With front and back pockets, these pants are as functional as they are stylish. Plus, they have UV protection of 20+. Pair them with a cool golf shirt and enjoy a sunny day on the course.
 

 
The Noah pants are Galvin Green’s best selling men’s golf pants and this style comes in 21 sizes (yes, 21 sizes!) Made from an extremely breathable, quick dry fabric, these pants are ideal for golfing in cool or warm weather. The fabric, available in a range of colours, has a mechanical stretch allowing for comfort and freedom of movement while you’re playing golf.

Nova - Breathable golf shorts.descriptionEn: The Nova golf shorts are designed for comfort and performance, featuring VENTIL8™ PLUS technology for breathability and quick-dry properties. The mechanical stretch fabric ensures flexibility, while UV protection 20+ keeps you shielded from the sun. With front and back pockets for added convenience, these shorts are perfect for active golfers.

Paul - Breathable golf shorts.descriptionEn:
Made from lightweight and quick dry fabric, you’ll stay cool and dry when the temperatures heat up. These breathable golf shorts for men include a shirt gripper waistband and a built-in stretch function for comfort and a perfect fit. They come with UV protection of 20+ for added cover on sunny days, and the shorts include front and back pockets. Light, soft, and comfortable - these shorts look great on the golf course and during lunch at the clubhouse.
 

 
The Paul shorts are Galvin Green’s best selling breathable golf shorts for men, ideal for golf on sunny days. Made from a bluesign® approved fabric, the Paul shorts come in a wide range of options. Prefer classic colours? We’ve got them. Want to make a statement on the golf course? Choose a pair in a bright or bold tone.

Pedro - Breathable golf shorts.descriptionEn: The Pedro golf shorts are designed for comfort and performance, made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology for breathability and quick-dry properties. The mechanical stretch fabric ensures freedom of movement, while UV protection 20+ shields you from the sun. Front and back pockets offer practical storage, making these shorts perfect for long rounds on sunny days.

Percy - Breathable golf shorts.descriptionEn:
These woven four pocket men’s golf shorts have patch pockets at the back. Made from a bluesign® approved fabric, the Percy shorts are sustainable and easy to care for. Light, soft, and comfortable - these are our go-to shorts on sunny days, whether we are on the golf course or not.
 

 
The Percy men’s golf shorts are made from a super lightweight and extremely breathable fabric that’s ideal for hot weather golf. This quick dry material ensures you stay cool and dry on the golf course and UV protection of 15+ provides extra sun cover, while a mechanical stretch means you have full freedom of movement during the game.

Shade - Sun visor.descriptionEn:
The Shade golf sun visor has an adjustable circumference measuring 54 to 62 cm (21,3 to 24,4 inches.)
 

 
Skip the sunglasses — Shade is a lightweight golf sun visor with an adjustable circumference. Practical for golf, tennis, and many outdoor activities, this versatile piece is a handy item to have on hand.

Shane - Breathable golf hat.descriptionEn: The Shane golf hat combines style and performance with a contrasting brim and front Galvin Green embroidery. Made from a structured fabric, this cap features ventilation holes for enhanced breathability, while the adjustable width ensures a custom fit.

Wilton - Golf belt.descriptionEn: The Wilton golf belt is designed with versatility in mind, featuring a sturdy woven band and a sleek metal buckle. Its innovative “track fit” micro-adjustment system ensures a precise and comfortable fit. With a reversible design, this belt lets you effortlessly switch between two colours.
